summary: workflowcheck incorrectly flags net/url.Parse as non-deterministic in Go 1.26 because its internals call garbage collection functions that the static analyzer marks as non-deterministic, preventing users from using this standard library function in workflows.
userImpact: Users cannot use net/url.Parse in workflows without receiving false positive non-determinism warnings from workflowcheck.
rootCause: Go 1.26 commit ff654ea modified net/url.Parse internals to include garbage collection function calls, which are flagged as non-deterministic by the static analyzer even though URL parsing itself is deterministic.
proposedFix: Update workflowcheck to properly handle Go 1.26 standard library changes and recognize that net/url.Parse is functionally deterministic despite internal GC calls.
resolutionDetails: Go 1.26 introduced changes in net/url.Parse that triggered false positives in determinism analysis. The fix updates workflowcheck to handle these standard library patterns correctly.
keyQuote: This was due to https://github.com/golang/go/commit/ff654ea. We found other Go 1.26 issues in #2188 too.
